header: Monitoring audit logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
If your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain uses ﬁne-grained access control, you can enable
audit logs for your data. Audit logs are highly customizable and let you track user activity on
your OpenSearch clusters, including authentication success and failures, requests to OpenSearch,
index changes, and incoming search queries. The default conﬁguration tracks a popular set of user
actions, but we recommend tailoring the settings to your exact needs.
Just like OpenSearch application logs and slow logs, OpenSearch Service publishes audit logs to
CloudWatch Logs. If enabled, standard CloudWatch pricing applies.
Note
To enable audit logs, your user role must be mapped to the security_manager role,
which gives you access to the OpenSearch plugins/_security REST API. To learn more,
see the section called “Modifying the master user”.
